summary.intent: Fix a failing prettier lint check in CI for PR #485 (feat/api-unpin-integrity) and then run /resolve-pr-reviews on it.
summary.outcome: Lint errors in pending-unpin.processor.spec.ts were fixed via eslint --fix and the commit was pushed to re-trigger CI. The /resolve-pr-reviews step was not yet executed.

repo: Project uses prettier enforced via eslint in the apps/api workspace; single-element arrays must be collapsed to one line per prettier config.
Repo uses 1Password SSH signing, requiring git commits to run unsandboxed to avoid signing failures.

code.finding: Two prettier violations: single-element arrays written across multiple lines instead of inline. eslint --fix collapsed them correctly.

workflow: eslint --fix scoped to a single file is sufficient for prettier-only violations and avoids noisy diffs.
Checking the failed CI lint job log directly is the fastest way to identify which files and rules need fixing.

friction: 1Password SSH signing requires commits to run unsandboxed in the background, adding friction to the normal commit flow.
CI lint failure blocked PR #485 from merging despite the fix being trivial (2 prettier formatting lines).
open_items: Run /resolve-pr-reviews on PR #485 once CI passes the re-triggered lint check.
Confirm CI goes green after the push before considering the PR ready.
